newsitem.title: USA: Indiana Bond Bank has new executive director.
newsitem.headline: Indiana Bond Bank has new executive director.

text.p: Donna Nichols has been named the new executive director of the Indiana Bond Bank, replacing Jim Higgins who resigned earlier this month.
Nichols served as general counsel to the organization and deputy state treasurer before her appointment to the post earlier in May, Indiana Treasurer Joyce Brinkman said in a news release.
Nichols previously worked 10 years in the state attorney general's office administering personnel policies and supervising the accounting department. She has a law degree from Indiana University.
